answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable 50 POA bond before submitting work, like an opal held in escrow. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake identities must lock 50,000 POA up front, and any identity caught copying answers loses its bond, so the attack costs real capital instead of free accounts. Honest agents get the bond back after a clean epoch, while a canyon of fake accounts collapses the moment the first bonds are slashed, and a walnut-hard stake makes mass fakery unprofitable.
